thread:
Anya: Quick sync - customer (cust_123, payments) pressed for a compact deliverable: eval-triggered alerts + automated quantization recs + sane batching/caching defaults. Can we scope this for a 2-week pilot? Who can own pieces?
Mike: I can own batching + caching defaults. Need clarity on target SLOs and acceptable p99 tail.
Kevin: Heads-up: aggressive batching saves $$ but spikes tail latency. We should map two profiles: latency-first and throughput-first. Also need per-tenant caps.
Claire: Customer asks: alert when eval-concordance drops >5% on their golden prompt set, and automated rec to try int8 + KV cache with rollback guidance. Is 5% too strict?
Srini: 5% is reasonable for payments flows. For background features 10% is fine. For quant recs: propose two buckets - "safe" (int8 + minimal perf tests) and "experimental" (int4, sampling-based validation). We can auto-run small evals before recommending.
Mike: For rollout, propose default batching config: 
```
batching_profile: "latency-first"
max_batch_size: 16
max_wait_ms: 8
kv_cache_enabled: true
```
And an API endpoint to surface recs: POST /optimize/recommendations { model, avg_seq_len, p50_latency, eval_set_id }
Claire: Alert UX: customers should opt-in per-route. Alert payload: drift_pct, affected_prompts, suggested_action (e.g., "apply int8+kv-cache"), risk_level.
Jen: Ops constraints: eval-triggered alerts must create a ticket + optional webhook to customer's pager. Need opt-in and retention (retain eval artifacts 30d). Also add a rate limit so noisy eval sets don't spam.
eval-bot: eval-run for cust_123 finished - metric=golden_concordance drift=6.2% :warning: Suggested rec = int8 + enable-kv-cache (safe).
Kevin: If we auto-suggest quant changes, we must provide an automatic canary path: route 5% traffic to quantized variant + compare latencies/errors for 24h. If regressions > threshold, auto-revert.
Anya: Next steps/todo: Mike -> draft batching defaults + API sketch. Srini -> quant rec logic + staging eval plan. Claire -> alert acceptance criteria + opt-in UX. Jen -> ops runbook and retention policy. Kevin -> canary rollback safety checks. Meeting tomorrow 9:30am to lock scope. :thumbsup:
Mike: Ack, will post a short PR with defaults by EOD.
Srini: Will prototype int8 gating test on staging and share eval harness.
Claire: I'll write acceptance criteria doc and link it here before the meeting.
Jen: I'll stub runbook + retention notes.
Anya: Thanks - trying to keep the pilot minimal but actionable. If anyone spots a major blocker, ping me.
